description: Les Lilas: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Les Lilas. Coverage: Les Lilas. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Arrêtés de voirie 2022; Arrêtés de voirie 2024; Arrêtés de voirie 2023; arrêtés de voirie 2026. Formats seen: PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
